public_delta.note: ValueBindContext replaces the former name without an alias; four Grid/List constructor options and one List refresh method are added. shared_context_and_options.outcome: Rename FormValueContext to ValueBindContext without an alias and preserve its fields. Expose beforeBindValue/onBindValue on Grid/List and ListHandle.refresh; capture references and reject malformed hook options before ownership.
shared_context_and_options.remaining: Broader declaration/default/whole-Form inheritance and all full owners remain required.

shared_checked_value_owner.outcome: Extract Form callback invocation, synchronous/thenable/error and native/choice replacement checks into one private owner, preserving Form details/causes and using binder-specific Grid/List errors. Before transforms raw for the writer and after observes/replaces once; undefined preserves and false/null/zero/empty text remain data.
shared_checked_value_owner.remaining: No public helper, callback-layer engine or generic utility. One composed application function remains one callback unit.

raw_projection_cache_and_focus.outcome: Keep raw source/validation/parser/draft/formatter/change ownership separate from callback projection. Cache successful unchanged fields only with hooks, recheck typed choices after source-option changes, bypass drafts and restore committed raw on editable Grid focus with cached display on blur.
raw_projection_cache_and_focus.remaining: Pure row validation and detached/offscreen probes do not run hooks. Grid revealInvalid may mount a real invalid row, whose ordinary value projection then runs. Local-source/per-unbound-key outcomes remain required.

mounted_phase_lifetime_and_failure.outcome: Use bind for creation/remount/explicit refresh and val for retained committed raw changes. Hidden retained List records get no invented callback elements; later show binds. Opt-in source/generation/reentry checks stop stale framework writes and placement; failures drain rejection, keep causes, release failed construction and permit retry.
mounted_phase_lifetime_and_failure.remaining: No-hook fast paths retain existing context/checkpoint allocation behavior; row/completion/selection ordering remains owned by existing binders.

explicit_live_policy_and_refresh.outcome: Use an application-owned mutable policy read by stable plain forwarding callbacks across independent Form/Grid/List handles. Explicit refresh applies deliberate policy changes to unchanged visible data without Rows writes or selection/disposal changes.
explicit_live_policy_and_refresh.remaining: No global registry, implicit inherited settings, JSON cloning or hot constructor reconfiguration; wider global/default equivalence remains required.

real_example_and_installed.outcome: Reuse the actual active-to-Active/Inactive example projection on authored static spans while retaining native checkbox behavior. Verify renamed public types/old-name rejection and callbacks/refresh in exact-package JS/TS and five Windows browser consumers.
real_example_and_installed.remaining: Example paths/semantic documents and exact witnesses are finalized only after implementation; no full-family closure or omitted capability is implied.
